Overnight rye with a rye starter

A dense loaf that keeps for four days. The long cold proof does most of the work, so the hands-on time is under twenty minutes.

Advertisement: flour subscription boxes

Table 1: Timings
StageTimeTemperature
Autolyse40 minutesRoom
Bulk3 hours24 C
Cold proof12 hours5 C

Ingredients

  • 400 g rye flour
  • 100 g wheat flour
  • 380 g water at 30 C
  • 120 g rye starter
  • 9 g salt

Method

  1. Mix the flours and the water and leave them for forty minutes.
  2. Add the starter and the salt and fold every thirty minutes for three hours.
  3. Shape, then refrigerate overnight in a linen-lined basket.
  4. Bake at 250 C for twenty minutes with steam, then twenty without.

Tip: rye dough stays sticky, so wet your hands instead of adding flour.

Cool the loaf completely before slicing, or the crumb will gum up.
